contract.operation: forward sparse convolution; submanifold coordinate fixtures
contract.output_layout: TILE_LAYOUT, device DRAM, original output row order
contract.timing: host wall time including all required device operations and synchronization; excludes compilation, initial input upload, output download and static preparation
contract.score: per-case median completed-operator latency; geometric mean for synthetic coverage only; application score requires measured occurrence counts
contract.workspace_scope: temporary tensors beyond resident input, output, weights and topology; estimates must be labeled, allocator snapshots are not peaks
contract.promotion: all selected correctness gates pass, evaluator/corpus hashes unchanged, and paired timing improvement exceeds measured baseline noise
contract.known_failure_policy: report numerical_failure; never convert xfail into a pass or exclude it silently

scope: host wall time with synchronization around each top-level TTNN call; overlap is changed; stage times overlap operation times; not device-only timing or a promotion score
